question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority as General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, chairman of the Central Military Commission, and state president underpins the 95.9% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Recent military leadership changes, including the early-2026 investigation of senior figures such as Zhang Youxia, have further centralized control without evident factional pushback or institutional challenges. No leadership transition is scheduled before the 21st Party Congress in autumn 2027, and public appearances through mid-2026 show policy continuity rather than elite realignment. Low-probability shifts could still arise from an unforeseen health event, a severe economic downturn fostering internal consensus against him, or an external crisis that fractures elite cohesion before December 2026.
